messages:
people-ops: Quick drop 12; promotion-readiness micro-kit for goal conversations. Short scripts + a tiny scoring checklist managers can copy into 1:1s or calibration notes. :rocket:

people-ops: Senior individual contributor script (30-45s):
```
Manager: "What one outcome will define growth for you this cycle, and what measurable signals will show progress?"
IC: "Reduce p95 latency of search requests by 20% and mentor two engineers; deliver a rollout runbook."
Manager: "Nice. We'll schedule monthly check-ins, pair you with L for perf reviews, and add a dashboard panel."
```

people-ops: Manager-track / promotion-readiness probe (concise):
```
Manager: "Which outcomes did you drive across teams this year? Give a short example of where you removed ambiguity or influenced direction."
IC: "Led cache redesign: aligned product + infra, cut infra costs 18%, and wrote the migration playbook."
Manager: "Let's capture the PRs, dashboard metrics, and a one-page decision log to include in calibration."
```

people-ops: Stretch-project alignment prompt:
```
Manager: "What's the smallest measurable experiment we can run in 6 weeks to validate this idea?"
IC: "Gated experiment on 10% of traffic; metric = engagement lift vs control. If green, expand to beta."
Manager: "Block two sprints and schedule a cross-team sync for rollout planning."
```

people-ops: Two-week check-in card (copyable):
""Hey — quick 1:1 check on [goal]. Signal update: [metric/artifact]. Blockers: [x]. Next step: [y].""

people-ops: Tiny scoring checklist (paste in notes; 1=low, 3=strong):
- Scope focus: 1-3
- Measurability: 1-3
- Org impact: 1-3
- Leadership signals: 1-3

people-ops: Suggested artifacts to bring: PR links, dashboard panel link, one-line decision log, short demo recording (2-3 min). Cadence: 2-week tactical check-ins, monthly calibration + promotion-readiness review.

alex_k: This is great. Can you add example metrics under each role? Managers want concrete numbers they can paste.

people-ops: Added examples: Senior IC metrics = p95 latency (ms), percent CPU saved; Manager-track metrics = cross-team delivery % on-time, customer satisfaction delta (NPS or CSAT change).

michelle: Request: include a one-line Slack blurb managers can post to set expectations for a promotion conversation.

people-ops: Slack blurb (copy-paste): "Heads-up: starting promotion-readiness chats this month. Please bring 1-2 artifacts (PRs, dashboard) and a one-line outcome you own. See micro-kit in Confluence."

sam: Can you also drop a suggested 1:1 agenda with timeboxes?

people-ops: Sure 12; 1:1 agenda (20 min):
- 3 min: quick status / metric update
- 7 min: artefact walkthrough (PR/dashboard)
- 6 min: blockers & support needed
- 4 min: next steps + confirmation of artifacts for calibration

people-bot: note: confluence page created at /people-ops/promotion-microkit (restricted to org).

alex_k: Thanks! I'll use this in my upcoming 1:1s.

michelle: Saved. Appreciate the short, copyable bits. :sparkles:"
